gloss: the back (of a building); rear side; back area

definitions.gloss: the back (of a building); rear side; back area
definitions.explanation: The physical area behind a building or structure. Used to describe the rear or back side of locations, typically in giving directions or describing spatial relationships.

examples.japanese: ⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{裏手|うらて}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{回|まわ}る→回る：01150_mawaru⟧。
examples.english: Go around to the back of the building.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{裏手|うらて}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{小|ちい}さな→小さな：02913_chiisana⟧⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a small park behind the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{裏手|うらて}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がっていて→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧、⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{豊|ゆた}か→豊か：03654_yutaka⟧だった。
examples.english: Behind the school, mountains stretched out, and the area was rich in nature.

notes:
Refers to the back or rear side of a building, structure, or location. Typically used for the physical area behind something rather than an abstract concept.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{裏手|うらて}: the back of a building
- ⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{裏手|うらて}: behind the house
- {裏手|うらて}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{回|まわ}る→回る：01150_mawaru⟧: to go around to the back
- {裏手|うらて}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: to come out at the back

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{裏側|うらがわ}→裏側：03042_uragawa⟧: reverse side — can be used for flat objects as well as buildings
- ⟦{裏|うら}→裏：02178_ura⟧: back — more general; also means the hidden or reverse side of things
- ⟦{背面|はいめん}→背面：20610_haimen⟧: rear surface — more formal and technical
